aweme_detail.desc: I wanna know your keyboard size. #gamingkeyboard #GamingSetup #mechanicalkeyboard #GamingTips

transcript:
WEBVTT


00:00:00.000 --> 00:00:01.980
What your keyboard size says about you.

00:00:01.981 --> 00:00:04.161
You try hard in every game.

00:00:04.180 --> 00:00:07.260
You don't use team chat because you physically can't,

00:00:07.261 --> 00:00:09.041
and you also don't like fun.

00:00:09.300 --> 00:00:12.320
You think you're better because you didn't buy a 65%,

00:00:12.380 --> 00:00:14.480
but there's literally no difference.

00:00:14.940 --> 00:00:17.360
The perfect keyboard size for everything.

00:00:17.820 --> 00:00:19.660
You're good at gaming, work,

00:00:19.661 --> 00:00:22.361
and school, and you're very rich.

00:00:22.580 --> 00:00:27.780
You bought it for the function keys
